segments.t: En el tranquilo pasillo trasero detrás de la cocina, Hannah y Graham contemplan una alta estantería de madera repleta de viejas guías de viaje. Tessa sale deprisa del rincón de la cafetería limpiándose la harina de las manos. Escuchemos primero.
Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?
Help me stack these big green books on the chair, Tessa.
Take the top shelf first so the wood becomes light.
These travel books are older than both of us, Hannah!
That is the last shelf. Ready to pull on three, Graham?
One, two, three... slide the left side toward me!
Look behind the wood! White paint and a brass keyhole!
A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!
Let us try the big key from the cedar box.
Does it turn, Graham?
One firm turn to the right... and the latch is open!
Lift the handle first, just like the front door!
Repasemos ahora cada intervención con calma.
Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?
'¿Es verdad? ¿De verdad hay una habitación secreta detrás de la pared de mi cocina?'
Help me stack these big green books on the chair, Tessa.
'Ayúdame a apilar estos libros grandes y verdes en la silla, Tessa.'
Take the top shelf first so the wood becomes light.
'Vacía primero el estante de arriba para que la madera quede ligera.'
These travel books are older than both of us, Hannah!
'¡Estos libros de viajes son más viejos que nosotras dos, Hannah!'
That is the last shelf. Ready to pull on three, Graham?
'Ese es el último estante. ¿Listo para tirar a la de tres, Graham?'
One, two, three... slide the left side toward me!
'Uno, dos, tres... ¡desliza el lado izquierdo hacia mí!'
Look behind the wood! White paint and a brass keyhole!
'¡Miren detrás de la madera! ¡Pintura blanca y un ojo de cerradura de latón!'
A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!
'¡Una puerta de verdad, escondida justo aquí en el pasillo!'
Let us try the big key from the cedar box.
'Probemos la llave grande de la caja de cedro.'
Does it turn, Graham?
'¿Gira, Graham?'
One firm turn to the right... and the latch is open!
'Un giro firme hacia la derecha... ¡y el pestillo está abierto!'
Lift the handle first, just like the front door!
'¡Levanta primero la manilla, igual que en la puerta principal!'
Volvamos a escuchar toda la escena seguida.
Is it true? Is there really a secret room behind my kitchen wall?
Help me stack these big green books on the chair, Tessa.
Take the top shelf first so the wood becomes light.
These travel books are older than both of us, Hannah!
That is the last shelf. Ready to pull on three, Graham?
One, two, three... slide the left side toward me!
Look behind the wood! White paint and a brass keyhole!
A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!
Let us try the big key from the cedar box.
Does it turn, Graham?
One firm turn to the right... and the latch is open!
Lift the handle first, just like the front door!
La pesada estantería ya está a un lado y la cerradura oculta gira limpia al primer intento. Qué bien se enlazan esas acciones cotidianas: apilar, tirar, deslizar y abrir. Hasta la próxima.
See you later!
